text: Lets any Python or Node.js program join a LiveKit room as a full realtime participant
quote: The Agents framework lets you add any Python or Node.js program to LiveKit rooms as full realtime participants.

text: Build and deploy a working voice assistant in under 10 minutes using Python or Node.js
quote: Build and deploy a simple voice assistant with Python or Node.js in less than 10 minutes.

text: LiveKit Inference lets you run AI models without needing your own API keys
quote: LiveKit Inference for running AI models without API keys.

text: Adaptive interruption handling distinguishes intentional barge-ins from casual backchanneling so the agent responds naturally
quote: Adaptive interruption handling allows an agent to respond naturally when users speak mid-response... to identify intentional interruptions (barge-ins) from conversational backchanneling.

text: TurnDetector model encodes user audio to capture both words and how they're spoken for turn-taking decisions
quote: LiveKit's `TurnDetector` is an audio model that encodes user audio directly, capturing both _what_ is said and _how_ it's said.

text: Agents can call external APIs or look up data to support retrieval-augmented generation
quote: Call external APIs or lookup data for RAG.

text: Many LLM providers offer built-in server-side tools executed within a single API call
quote: Many LLM providers, including OpenAI, Gemini, and SpaceXAI, include built-in server-side tools that are executed entirely within a single API call.

text: Native MCP support lets you integrate tools from MCP servers with one line of code
quote: MCP support: Native support for MCP. Integrate tools provided by MCP servers with one line of code.

text: Any code — AI agents, media processors, or custom logic — can join a room as a programmatic participant
quote: A programmatic participant is any code that joins a LiveKit room as a participant — this includes AI agents, media processors, or custom logic that processes realtime streams.

text: Behavioral tests verify specific agent interactions and integrate with pytest or Vitest test suites
quote: Behavioral tests verify specific interactions and expected outcomes. They integrate with your existing test suite using pytest (Python) or Vitest (Node.js)

text: Agent simulations run full end-to-end conversations against an LLM-driven simulated user and evaluate the results
quote: Agent simulations run end-to-end conversations between your agent and an LLM-driven user, then evaluate the results across the full interaction.

text: Built-in test framework includes judges to automatically assess whether the agent performed as expected
quote: Builtin test framework: Write tests and use judges to ensure your agent is performing as expected.

text: Integrates with LiveKit's telephony stack so agents can place or receive phone calls
quote: Works seamlessly with LiveKit's telephony stack, allowing your agent to make calls to or receive calls from phones.

text: Includes an embedded, secure TURN server with authentication integrated into the LiveKit stack
quote: The good news is LiveKit includes an embedded TURN server. It's a secure TURN implementation that has integrated authentication with the rest of LiveKit.

text: Large ecosystem of open source plugins connects agents to many different AI providers
quote: LiveKit Agents includes a large ecosystem of open source plugins for a variety of AI providers.

text: Agent Builder lets you prototype and deploy voice agents directly in the browser with no code
quote: Prototype and deploy voice agents directly in your browser, without writing any code.

text: Instant rollback to a previous agent deployment
quote: Instant rollback to a previous agent deployment

text: Full support for LLM tool use lets you build a custom library of tools to extend agent context
quote: LiveKit Agents has full support for LLM tool use. This feature allows you to create a custom library of tools to extend your agent's context

text: Access many AI models via LiveKit Inference on LiveKit Cloud, or connect directly via open source provider plugins
quote: You can use LiveKit Inference to access many of these models directly through LiveKit Cloud, or you can use the open source plugins to connect directly to a wider range of model providers.

text: Telephony support lets you build voice apps that handle both inbound and outbound calls
quote: LiveKit telephony lets you build AI-powered voice apps that handle inbound and outbound calls.

text: Secure self-hosted deployment requires a domain and SSL certificate
quote: In order to have a secure LiveKit deployment, you will need a domain as well as a SSL certificate for that domain.

text: Built for AI coding agents like Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex to provision and operate agents
quote: LiveKit is built for coding agents like Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex.

text: Agents can run on LiveKit Cloud's global infrastructure for scale
quote: Run your agent on LiveKit Cloud's global infrastructure.

text: Outbound SIP trunks let the agent place outgoing phone calls
quote: Outbound trunks are used to place outgoing calls.

text: You can override the API key and base URL for any LLM, STT, or TTS provider not natively included
quote: For any provider not included, you can override the API key and base URL at initialization for the LLM, STT, and TTS interfaces in the plugin.
